evidence: RESOLVED: round-1 MINOR 1 (unauthorized 1e-12). evaluate_semantic_shadow keeps 1e-12 only on cohort_gain (mrr_gain + 1e-12 >= 0.02 or recall_gain + 1e-12 >= 0.02). protected_recall_not_reduced, per-suite negative_abstention and latency_within_bound are exact >= or <=. Equality passes; a 1e-13 regression fails in unit tests and /tmp probes. A 0.02-1e-13 cohort MRR gain still passes; 0.02-2e-12 fails. PROMOTION_POLICY values are unchanged.

RESOLVED: round-1 MINOR 2 (whole-report canary). After assembly, the evaluator serializes the whole report with durable.canonical_json and, if any in-memory runtime canary UTF-8 bytes occur, sets gates.privacy_canary false, recomputes held_reasons, and sets status to held because not every gate holds. _redact_canaries then walks strings, lists and dicts including keys and replaces each canary substring with privacy_canary_redacted. Redaction runs only after that gate and status update and does not recompute them, so it cannot hide a leak from the gate or turn a held report into a promotable one. A would-be-promotable synthetic report with a leaked case id became held with privacy_canary false and promotion_authorized false; the returned canonical JSON contained no canary.

MINOR: round-1 MINOR 3 is NOT RESOLVED. Most gate-failure unit tests still mock _run_suite. Live helper tests still cover digest pinning, drift memo, privacy refusals and R15 sampling. Fix round 1 did not add live retrieval gate-failure tests.

NOTE: palimnex.tests.test_semantic_eval 17/17 passed; mypy --disallow-untyped-defs on palimnex/semantic_eval.py is clean; implementation-receipt validator status valid; /tmp/phase4_eval_fix1_probes.py 72/72 passed.

NOTE: PROMOTION_POLICY remains limit 5, min_mrr_gain 0.02, min_recall_gain 0.02, min_additional_passes 1, max_p95_multiplier 1.5, gain_rule mrr_or_recall, pinned by the v1 schema. Sixteen gates are unchanged. status is promotable only when every gate is true. COHORT_SHA256 equals cohort-freeze.json and palimnex/evaluation/semantic-shadow.v1.json (bfaa3998bc8c8ae5d05959f51e71aae08bf14f339a55fc0924d7e0b7b9ef4200). R15 remains one shared memo, one discarded warmup, three measured repetitions, baseline-first on even reps and semantic-first on odd reps, nearest-rank p95. promotion_authorized, retrieval_influence and authorizes_actions stay false; authority is evidence_only.

NOTE: _redact_canaries walks str/list/dict only. An injected tuple leak still failed privacy_canary and stayed held; the canary remained in that non-production artifact. Assembled reports use dict, list, str, number, bool and null, which the rewrite covers. The post-redaction _canonical_safe call is a canonicalizability check, not a second canary scan.
